baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agentive plural النَّازِعَاتِ is governed by ن ز ع, while غَرْقًا supplies a second root image that can mark the reach of the action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Extraction from a settled place combines with exhaustive occupation: plural agents or forces remove something so thoroughly that the action reaches through the whole relevant field.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting or extracting a thing from its place supplies the core displacement and its resistance.
Exhaustive occupation or absorption supplies total reach as the action's degree.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names unspecified pullers performing an intense pull.
changed_reading.after: It evokes plural forces effecting a resistant displacement all the way through, with غَرْقًا marking exhaustive extent rather than merely manner.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots contain mutually fitting bow branches: ن ز ع names drawing the string and غ ر ق names reaching the limit of that draw.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first word supplies the tensile act and the second its maximal endpoint, yielding a compact image of stored force brought to full extension.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a bowstring supplies a precise tensile action for the participial agents.
Drawing a bow to its utmost limit supplies the completion and intensity of that same action.

changed_reading.before: The two words contribute unrelated images of pulling and immersion.
changed_reading.after: They lock into one technical image: drawers bringing tension to the furthest effective draw.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ن ز ع has a death-throes branch and غ ر ق has literal engulfment to destruction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Terminal struggle and engulfing depth combine into an extraction at the boundary of life, without yet identifying either the agents or what they remove.

activation_trace.role: The death-throes image supplies a terminal bodily threshold to the pulling action.
Engulfment in water through destruction supplies overwhelming extremity.

changed_reading.before: The pull is an ordinary physical removal.
changed_reading.after: The pull operates at a terminal threshold, as an overwhelming extraction bound up with mortal struggle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ز ع inventory permits an inward inclination toward a desired object, while غ ر ق permits total absorption.
baseline_models.mechanism: Attractive impulses pull inward attention toward desired objects until the desired field occupies the self completely; the plural participle is read as personified pulls or attractions.

activation_trace.role: Inclination of the self toward what it seeks supplies attraction rather than outward extraction.
Total absorption supplies the point at which attraction occupies the whole field of attention.

changed_reading.before: The agents pull an external object away from its place.
changed_reading.after: The agents can be personified attractions that pull the self toward a desired object until it is wholly engrossed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus action becomes the high-resistance first phase of an ordered operation: exhaustive disengagement gives way to rapid release, free traversal, overtaking, and finally consequence-aware direction of an affair.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from a fixed place supplies the operation's resistant opening phase.
Exhaustive reach makes the opening disengagement complete before the sequence advances.
Rapid drawing or extraction supplies a quicker second phase after the focus's resistant pull.
Running or swimming supplies unhindered traversal once disengagement has occurred.
Advancing in a race turns traversal into precedence and arrival ahead.
Considering an affair's outcome supplies purposeful governance as the sequence's result.
The image of an affair or state supplies the object brought under that governance.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 repeats feminine plural active participles with emphatic action nouns, while the conjunction shifts to ف at 79:4-5, supporting acceleration toward an outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical and grammatical progression from pulling through motion and precedence to management; I infer successive functional phases of one operation. A live alternative is that these are independent sworn classes whose actions are only rhetorically adjacent.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a self-contained act of exhaustive removal.
changed_reading.after: It describes the difficult opening stroke in a coordinated operation whose released motion culminates in directed consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired disturbance, return to an original state, decay, renewed recurrence, and one abrupt vocal impulse turn exhaustive extraction into the de-anchoring phase of a total state reversal rather than isolated removal.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from a settled place supplies the initiating de-anchoring.
Exhaustive reach scales that de-anchoring to the whole affected state.
Severe disturbance supplies the first visible consequence of a state losing stability.
A second thing arriving after the first supplies a paired, ordered upheaval.
Return to a place supplies reversal rather than simple onward destruction.
Return to the first condition sharpens the reversal as restoration of an earlier state.
Decay supplies the resistant terminal condition from which reversal is questioned.
Return and repetition supply renewed occurrence after apparent finality.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the abrupt impulse that completes the reversal.
Numerical oneness compresses the triggering impulse into a single event.

structural_cues: After the five-part opening motion sequence, 79:6-14 moves through two disturbances, a question about return from decay, and an immediate single-trigger reappearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss of stability, doubled disturbance, explicit return vocabulary, decay, and a single activating cry; I infer that the focus pull initiates the same comprehensive reversal. The opening agents could instead operate only alongside, not causally before, these events.

changed_reading.before: Exhaustive extraction ends with the object removed.
changed_reading.after: Exhaustive extraction is the first side of a larger reversal: a settled order is pulled loose so that even a decayed state can be returned at one impulse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contested-pull branch of ن ز ع becomes social and political: one party exceeds bounds, gathers others, and asserts elevation, but is then seized and made a deterrent. The focus can image power being wrested away across its entire claimed domain.

activation_trace.role: Mutual pulling between two sides supplies a struggle over possession or authority.
Occupation of the whole field scales dispossession across the full claimed domain.
Exceeding the boundary in disobedience supplies the illegitimate expansion that provokes reversal.
Driving and gathering a group supplies the social field over which control is asserted.
Self-exalting domination supplies the claim that is to be stripped away.
Seizure and capture reverse who holds whom.
Punishment that deters others converts the seizure into a public limit on overreach.

structural_cues: 79:17-25 narrates a progression from exceeded bounds through gathering and a highest claim to seizure and exemplary consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contested authority, collective gathering, elevation, seizure, and deterrence; I infer that the opening's total pull can model dispossession of arrogated control. The narrative may instead exemplify judgment without specifying the opening participles' domain.

changed_reading.before: The pull removes a physical object from a physical location.
changed_reading.after: The pull can wrest an overextended claim to control from its holder, completely reversing the relation of possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Within a built and stabilized order, hidden brightness, water, and pasture are brought out. Exhaustive extraction therefore need not be destructive: it can be the constructive disclosure of latent provision, balanced by acts of completion and anchoring.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from a prior location supplies bringing concealed contents into availability.
Exhaustive scope makes disclosure comprehensive rather than incidental.
Building by joining parts supplies the containing order within which extraction functions.
Integrity and completion supply constructive purpose rather than mere rupture.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies disclosure for the emergence of daylight.
The repeated bringing-out image extends disclosure from light to terrestrial provision.
Water supplies one concrete latent resource made available by bringing out.
Pasture supplies a second life-supporting output of the disclosure.
Firm anchoring supplies the stabilizing counter-operation to extraction.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 orders building, raising, completing, alternating concealment and emergence, spreading, bringing out resources, anchoring, and benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a constructed frame, two explicit bringing-out actions, provision, and anchoring; I infer that the focus's extraction can participate in constructive disclosure. A live alternative is that the opening extraction remains destructive and the creation sequence only demonstrates independent power.

changed_reading.before: Exhaustive removal is presumptively a destructive stripping-away.
changed_reading.after: Exhaustive removal can also be a generative bringing-forth of what was hidden, operating inside a stabilized order for provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the nearer life gives desire a target; the self is pulled toward it until engrossed, while deliberate restraint supplies an opposing pull. The focus's plural agents can thus be read as appetitive attractions within a moral force-field.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination toward a desired object supplies the inward pull.
Total absorption supplies the endpoint at which appetite occupies the self's whole field.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the decision that ratifies attraction.
Life construed as benefit or good supplies the attractive value attached to the object.
The nearer or lower world supplies the attraction's immediate horizon.
Restraint from an act supplies the active counterforce to inward attraction.
The living self supplies the contested locus acted on by attraction and restraint.
The self's inclination supplies an explicit context analogue for the focus root's desire branch.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 forms a contrast between exceeding bounds and preferring the nearer life on one side, and fearing, restraining the self, and reaching refuge on the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, valued nearness, a living self, desire, and restraint; I infer a tug-of-war in which attractions can be personified by the opening participle. The alternative is that this context prescribes a response while the opening agents remain wholly external.

changed_reading.before: The inward-pull baseline is an abstract lexical possibility without a mechanism.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a moral mechanism: attractive goods pull the self toward total engrossment, and restraint interrupts that pull.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending asks about the event's anchorage and endpoint, then contracts experienced duration to an evening or a morning. By opposition to anchoring, the focus's exhaustive removal can image temporal order itself being pulled from its moorings.

activation_trace.role: Removal from a settled place supplies the opening side of an anchoring/unmooring polarity.
Exhaustive scope scales the unmooring beyond one object to the experienced temporal field.
Firm settlement or anchorage supplies the explicit opposite pole from which unmooring is inferred.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the event's inaccessible terminal boundary.
Remaining in a place supplies duration that is retrospectively compressed.
Evening supplies one short boundary for the contracted measure of prior duration.
The forenoon's span supplies the alternate short boundary for that contracted duration.

structural_cues: 79:42-46 moves from asking when the event will be fixed, through its endpoint, to the radically shortened duration perceived when it is seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anchorage, endpoint, staying, and two short time measures; I supply the antonymic arrow from extraction to unmooring and extend its scope to temporal experience. The live alternative is that the opening only names agents active at the event, not a transformation of time itself.

changed_reading.before: The phrase concerns complete removal within an otherwise stable spatial world.
changed_reading.after: It can image a complete unmooring of the world's temporal stability, after which a long stay collapses in perception to part of a day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads 79:2-4 as mechanics of release and projectile travel even though no projectile is named. It remains live because the two focus roots have an unusually exact draw/full-draw pairing and the next roots supply loosening, rapid motion, and precedence. Downstream prose should present it as a kinetic analogy, not identify the participles categorically as archers or arrows.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ن ز ع B002 and غ ر ق B004 jointly anchor a full bow draw in the focus phrase itself.

activation_trace.role: Drawing the bowstring supplies stored tensile force.
The utmost bow draw supplies maximum loading before release.
A knot being tied or released supplies the transition from held tension to release.
Swift running or swimming supplies travel after release.
Racing ahead supplies the released motion's overtaking endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The bow image is a static lexical pairing confined to 79:1.
changed_reading.after: It can open a draw-release-flight-overtake kinetic sequence across 79:1-4.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it promotes a narrow water-drawing branch of ن ز ع and reads a morally used ط غ ي through its water-overflow branch. It remains anchored by literal water-drawing and drowning branches in 79:1, reinforced by a valley, overflow, manifested water, and anchoring elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should keep it as a hydraulic material analogy, not claim that the opening agents are water currents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ن ز ع B008 supplies water drawn by hand and غ ر ق B001 supplies immersion or drowning.

activation_trace.role: Drawing water by hand supplies hydraulic removal from a containing depth.
Immersion through drowning supplies the inverse movement of water overwhelming what it contains.
A valley as a flood channel supplies directed water movement through terrain.
Rising, overwhelming water supplies overflow as a material analogue for exceeded bounds.
Water appearing and becoming abundant supplies emergence from hidden storage.
Firm anchoring supplies stabilization against the field's draw and overflow.

changed_reading.before: The focus juxtaposes an extractor with fatal immersion.
changed_reading.after: It can stage a hydraulic polarity of drawing from depth versus engulfing overflow, later balanced by channels, emergence, and anchorage.

strongest_changes: The opening pull became the resistant first phase of a five-step operation ending in directed consequence.
The return-from-decay sequence changed exhaustive extraction from an endpoint into one side of a comprehensive state reversal.
The overreach narrative activated a social model in which claimed control is completely wrested from its holder.
The creation sequence showed that exhaustive extraction can disclose latent provision constructively, while anchoring supplies its balancing operation.
The final contrast between preference and restraint gave the inward-attraction baseline a concrete moral counter-pull.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots contain an exact bow draw/full-draw convergence, but the whole-surah packet also repeatedly converts the same extraction image across kinetic, restorative, political, constructive, appetitive, and temporal mechanisms without forcing one referent for the feminine plural agents.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the identity or concrete referent of النَّازِعَاتِ.
The syntactic force of غَرْقًا remains open among exhaustive degree, attendant state, and a more concrete branch image.
The opening participles may name successive phases of one operation or distinct coordinated classes.
The inward, temporal, bow-flight, and hydraulic readings remain analogical activations and should not be promoted to exclusive identifications.
